BiblicalUsage: Might is the strength of the hand. Moses warned Israel not to say in their hearts, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth, and Job cried that God had become cruel to him and opposed him with His strong hand.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the might of my own hand is the most dangerous thing I own: it makes me say, my power got me this, and forget the Lord who gave it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
